reasoning: The question asks if North Atlantic daily SST will exceed its historical record for any given day between Feb 1 and May 1, 2026. As of March 6, 2026, we're already 5 weeks into this window. The background notes that 2025 saw exceptionally high temperatures, and 2026 has started lower than 2025. However, seasonal warming typically occurs through spring (Feb-May in Northern Hemisphere). The key factors: (1) 2025 set very high records due to reduced SO2 emissions and El Niño effects, (2) 2026 is currently running cooler than 2025, (3) there are still ~7 weeks remaining in the window for potential record-breaking, (4) spring warming could push temperatures higher. Given that 2025 was anomalously warm and 2026 is tracking cooler, beating daily records from 2025 seems unlikely but not impossible if conditions align favorably. The probability should reflect the difficulty of beating recent records while acknowledging remaining time and seasonal warming potential.
